scope: Parentless public untyped sole backed block &get through a literal property and direct ordinary CV receiver. An explicit scalar or implicit-null backing supplies a live alias without a property type source; ordinary reads copy after hook cleanup, receiver retirement preserves escaped aliases, and destination rebind invokes Get before the overloaded-object Error.

target.environment: LC_ALL=C; TZ=UTC; serial CPU4; 100000 model steps and 75-second source timeout

authority: Zend/zend_inheritance.c::zend_verify_hooked_property installs a null default for an untyped backed hooked property with no explicit initializer.
Zend/zend_execute.c::zend_assign_to_property_reference fetches Get before rejecting a hooked destination.
spec/semantics/138-property-references.watsup::$propref_attach_slot attaches OBJECT_PROP_SOURCE only when the declaration has a type.

accepted.coverage: Original-source full normal endings; live backing ALIAS cell; TYPE=eps and absent OBJECT_PROP_SOURCE; exact string bytes across alias writes and independent copies; receiver death with one escaped cell; original Error message, file and line; split/zero step budgets.

independent_controls.result: Frozen default-null untyped and typed-source guard sources independently match pinned native at 12b704f2d; typed coverage retains its CLASS132 cut.

review.basis: Two-gate source change, three exact clean source/state groups, frozen native/model default-null and typed controls, virtual Unsupported boundary, partial inventory and archived zero-credit failures.

unsupported_control.result: Untyped virtual &get is native normal G|aliased|Z|, while the checked model explicitly reports Unsupported at hook compilation. Zero semantic agreement.

preserved_zero_credit.prechange: All three original sources were Unsupported at hook compilation before the two type-presence gates changed.
preserved_zero_credit.fixture_compiler: First two focused attempts failed on an invalid slice binding and noninvertible concatenation, retained in the archive.
preserved_zero_credit.fixture_state: The next focused attempt assumed PSTRING storage where the model used a string carrier; it failed at the exact stored-value premise. Corrected checks use $string_bytes, and the original failure remains zero credit.
preserved_zero_credit.duplicate_module_attempt: An initial preliminary compiler command supplied spec/php.watsup twice; the tool exited zero with a duplicate statement declaration diagnostic. Its output file was overwritten by the corrected command; the failed command has no validation credit.

archive.recovery: Extract at the project root to restore private .tools raw reports, process exits, compiler output and failed attempts; the archive is outside Git.

remaining: Inherited reference getters, virtual/arrow/set/trait/paired declarations, dimensions, quiet/compound/coalesce consumers, undefined bind RHS and wider receiver/callback/lifetime cases remain partial.
